status: Synthetic numerical experiment; repository renderer was inaccessible.
renderer: 28x28 scanline bar. Rows y=4..23. Center x=13.5+lean*(y-13.5). Pixel intensity is overlap of [x-0.5,x+0.5] with [center-width/2,center+width/2]. Other pixels zero.
evaluation: Mean and 95th percentile of per-image RMSE across all 784 pixels in [0,1]. 1000 seeded independent uniform test parameter pairs. Seed 20261002; LCG state=(1664525*state+1013904223) modulo 2^32. PCA initializes two vectors using 784 random values each, before generating test pairs.

pca_2.training: 21x21 uniform parameter grid; mean-centered pixel covariance; two orthogonal power-iteration components, 70 iterations each

limitations: Two varying controls in a synthetic renderer, not the actual five-control generator.
Bilinear interpolation is supplied with the true parameter coordinates; it does not discover coordinates from images.
The additive baseline is also supplied with true parameters and exact one-control sweeps.
Mean errors include background pixels; they are not foreground-only or worst-pixel errors.
No principal-curve, principal-manifold, UMAP, autoencoder, or learned inverse model was fitted.
This checks interpolation and interaction, not global injectivity or rank across the domain.
